title: Truth-table size and query budget
statement: Let $r$ be a positive natural number and let $f:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$. The truth-table CNF formed from the assignments on which $f$ equals $+1$ has at most $r2^r$ clauses.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors of length $r$ to signs
